name: What are the signs of rot in a log cabin?

mainEntity.name: What are the signs of rot in a log cabin?

acceptedAnswer.text: Signs of rot in a log cabin include discoloration, softness or spongy texture when poked, crumbling wood, and a musty odor. You might also notice fungal growth or areas where the wood appears distorted or shrunken. Early detection is crucial to prevent the spread of rot.
acceptedAnswer.description: Discoloration, softness, crumbling wood, and musty odors are signs of rot.
